page: Microsoft Azure E16-8ads_v5 is a constrained-core, memory-optimized virtual machine configured on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Driven by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this instance allocates 8 dedicated vCPUs sourced from 4 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. The processor incorporates 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, supporting standard vector and cryptographic instruction sets including AVX, AES, and SHA_NI, while omitting AVX-512 extensions. It is paired with an expansive 128 GB of system memory, providing a high density of 16 GB of RAM per vCPU. The instance includes a bundled 644 GB local solid-state drive, offering direct high-speed local storage without requiring external attachment.

Benchmark evaluations reveal strong single-thread execution, with stress-ng single-core CPU throughput testing in the top 25 percent. Multi-core performance is moderate, reflecting its 4 physical core count, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 6293 and a PassMark CPU score of 11863.94. Memory subsystem benchmarks show small-block cached read throughput reaching 514.43 GB/sec, while uncached large-block write throughput drops to 22.49 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 25 percent. In-memory data structures perform reliably, achieving 8.13 million operations per second in Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput of 10.02 GB/sec. Machine learning inference for medium-sized language models exhibits lower prompt processing speeds, consistent with general-purpose CPU capabilities.

The core-constrained design of the E16-8ads_v5 provides a qualitative cost efficiency advantage for software stacks licensed on a per-core basis that demand large memory pools. The primary architectural tradeoff is the reduced multi-threaded computing capability and limited uncached write bandwidth relative to full-core variants. This server is best suited for memory-bound relational databases, large-scale caching servers, Redis deployments, and data transformation jobs that require substantial working memory alongside fast local temporary storage.
description: Microsoft Azure E16-8ads_v5 is a constrained-vCPU, memory-optimized virtual machine running on Microsoft Hyper-V. Powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz, it provides 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 4 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading. It features an expansive 128 GB of system memory, yielding a high ratio of 16 GB of RAM per vCPU, coupled with 644 GB of fast local SSD storage. Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU throughput alongside balanced mid-tier multi-core compute, decompression rates, and Redis key-value transaction performance. Memory write bandwidth to uncached large blocks registers in the lower quartile, presenting a potential constraint for sustained bulk write pipelines. The instance delivers cost efficiency for software that relies on extensive memory capacity while avoiding per-core software licensing penalties on surplus cores. It is suited for in-memory databases, caching infrastructure, data transformations, and enterprise memory-intensive workloads.
